verdict.rationale: The only machine-to-machine channel in evidence is EFILE/ReFILE, which lets certified tax software and enrolled electronic filers transmit returns system-to-system. It is gated behind a CRA certification process and filer enrollment, and no public API specification is shown. Everything else is web portals and forms, and canada.ca publishes no llms.txt or agent-oriented docs index. Missing for 10: an openly documented public API (spec/reference) usable by an ordinary or AI-native user, coverage beyond return filing (registration, payments, account management), and an agent-oriented docs index.
